sections.h2: When a whole-house repaint makes sense
body: Owners usually decide on interior house painting in Dunnellon, FL at a turning point: just bought the house, getting it ready to sell, finishing a renovation, or realizing every wall still carries the builder's flat paint. Doing it all at once means one color plan, one consistent trim white, matching sheens throughout, and one mobilization instead of several. It is a project our painters in Dunnellon plan in detail before day one. If you only need a few spaces, our room-by-room interior painting page is a better fit.

bullets: Walls in every room, closets optional and listed separately
Ceilings, with popcorn removal available, including a dustless option
Baseboards, casings, crown, and window trim
Interior doors and door frames in waterborne urethane enamel
Drywall repair throughout: nail pops, cracks, and old anchors
Stair rails and spindles where present

body: The right top-to-bottom sequence keeps a big job clean. Repairs and patching come first across the whole house, so primer can go on in one pass. Ceilings are painted before walls, since ceiling work drips and spatters down. Walls follow, then trim and doors last, so their crisp enamel edges sit on top of finished walls. In a house that holds humidity, each coat gets the dry time it needs before the next one goes on.

sections.h2: Living in the house while we work
body: You do not have to leave. Crews work in zones, usually a few rooms at a time, moving and covering furniture and leaving the rest of the house usable. Bedrooms are put back together at the end of each day where possible, and the kitchen and at least one bathroom stay in service. We talk through pets, work-from-home spaces, and anyone sensitive to odors during the walkthrough, and low-VOC products are available.

A whole-home interior usually runs anywhere from three days to two weeks, depending on square footage, ceiling height, repair needs, and how many colors are involved. The schedule is on the estimate before you sign.

sections.h2: One color plan for the whole house
body: A full repaint is the best moment to unify the palette. We can help with a flow of colors from room to room and match any existing shade from a chip or leftover can. Our article on interior paint colors for Florida homes is a good place to start. Many owners repaint the kitchen cabinets in the same project. More on our general process is on the interior painting service page.

faqs.q: How long does a whole-house interior take in Dunnellon?
faqs.a: Usually between three days and two weeks, depending on size, ceiling height, repairs, and the number of colors.

faqs.q: Do I need to move furniture before you arrive?
faqs.a: No. Crews move and protect furniture. We only ask that small valuables and wall items be put away.

faqs.q: Should I paint ceilings when I repaint the walls?
faqs.a: Usually yes. Ceilings yellow over time, and fresh walls make that easy to see. Doing them together also follows the right top-to-bottom order.

faqs.q: Can you paint a house before we move in?
faqs.a: Yes. An empty house is faster to paint, and it is a common time to schedule a whole-home interior.
